meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会记住每次对话的内容。每次回应前，它会自动回想与该话题相关的旧记忆；每轮对话结束后，它会把新信息存入记忆。这些记忆在容器重启后依然保留。
howto.when: 仅当 agent 组使用默认 Claude 提供方（container.json 中未设置 provider 或为 claude）时生效。每次 Claude 回应前自动调取相关记忆，每轮对话结束后自动存储新内容；使用其他提供方（如 opencode）的组不受影响。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次聊的那个项目吗？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中调取相关上下文。

say.text: 我喜欢简洁的回答，请记住。
say.note: Claude 会存储这个偏好并应用。

say.text: 我们之前提过的客户名字是什么？
say.note: Claude 会回忆之前的对话内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude remembers each conversation. Before replying, it automatically recalls old memories relevant to the topic; after each turn, it stores new information. Memories persist across container restarts.
howto.when_en: Only with the default Claude provider (no provider key or 'claude' in container.json). Memories are auto-recalled before each reply and new info is saved after each turn. Groups with other providers (e.g., opencode) are unaffected.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project we discussed last time?
say_en.note: Claude recalls relevant context from memory.

say_en.text: I prefer concise answers, please remember that.
say_en.note: Claude stores and applies this preference.

say_en.text: What was the client name we mentioned earlier?
